message:
🚀 HexPlayer v1.1.1 is here!

✨ What's New:
• Switch channels right from the player
• Keyboard shortcuts added
• Playlist reorder (drag & drop)
• Auto-refresh playlists (on open / 6h / 12h / 24h)
• Kodi-style playlist support (KODIPROP + DRM)
• Custom User-Agent support

⚡ Smoother, faster channel switching + optimized player
🐛 Fixed channel-switch freeze, header bugs & more
